title: AN ATLANTIC STYLE MODULAR ILLU...
reason: Large lit vintage-style ceramic Christmas tree with train and present base, bird bulbs; a recognised collectable type but no mark visible and may be hobby-made.
findings: Large multi-part illuminated ceramic Christmas tree in a glossy green glaze with dark streaking, on a hand-painted white base modelled as wrapped presents and a toy train. Many plastic bulbs in assorted colours and shapes, including bird-shaped bulbs, and a power cord attached. The look (tiered skirt, bird bulbs, white presents base) matches the 1970s Atlantic Mold style, consistent with the title, but no mould name, maker's mark, date or signature is visible (underside not shown), so it cannot be confirmed as a genuine Atlantic Mold piece rather than a hobby-ceramic copy. The base painting looks hand done.
condition: No chips or cracks visible on the tree tiers or presents in the two photos; bulbs look present and intact on the visible faces; cord looks intact; not tested. Tiers appear to separate (modular), so check all sections are present.
rescore_note: Large three-section lit ceramic tree with bird bulbs and a hand-painted presents and train base is a popular vintage type and looks intact, but no mould mark is visible (hobby-made copy likely), the electrics are untested and it is bulky and fragile; lower to middle of the $80-200 band (judgement, no live comps this run).
